hardwareSets.DESCRIPTION: Electrified · electrified panic, reader, power transfer, auto operator
hardwareSets.OPERATION: THE CARD READER ON THE PUSH SIDE OF THE DOOR WILL UNLOCK THE DOOR FOR AUTOMATIC OPERATION. THE INSIDE ACTIVATION SWITCH IS ALWAYS OPERABLE AND WILL AUTOMATICALLY OPEN THE DOOR FOR ACCESS TO THE PARING GARAGE. PUSHING THE PANIC HARDWARE WITHOUT PRESENTING A VALID CREDENTIAL WILL SOUND THE ALARM HORN AND DELAY EGRESS FOR 15-SECONDS BEFORE UNLOCKING. THE REQUEST TO EXIT SCANNER LOCATED ON THE PULL SIDE OF THE DOOR WILL INTERRUPT POWER TO THE MAG LOCK TO PERMIT FREE ACCESS FROM THE ELEVATOR LOBBY INTO THE PARKING GARAGE. THE DELAYED EGRESS LOCKING SYSTEM SHALL BE CONNECTED TO THE FIRE ALARM PANEL TO PERMIT THE DOOR TO UNLOCK FOR EGRESS. THE DOOR POSITION SWITCH IS MONITORED BY THE ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM.

THE CARD READER ON THE PUSH SIDE OF THE DOOR WILL UNLOCK THE DOOR FOR ENTRY. PUSHING THE PANIC HARDWARE WITHOUT PRESENTING A VALID CREDENTIAL WILL SOUND THE ALARM HORN AND DELAY EGRESS FOR 15-SECONDS BEFORE UNLOCKING. THE REQUEST TO EXIT SCANNER LOCATED ON THE PULL SIDE OF THE DOOR WILL INTERRUPT POWER TO THE MAG LOCK TO PERMIT FREE ACCESS FROM THE STAIR INTO THE SECURED SPACE. THE DELAYED EGRESS LOCKING SYSTEM SHALL BE CONNECTED TO THE FIRE ALARM PANEL TO PERMIT THE DOOR TO UNLOCK FOR EGRESS DURING ACTIVATION. THE DOOR POSITION SWITCH IS MONITORED BY THE ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM.

componentModels.name: LifeSafety Power LifeSafety FPO75/150/250 · Gen 2
componentModels.notes: DC1 and DC2 share one screw-terminal return; they are not two independent negative screw terminals. DC2 is FAI controlled. componentModels.name: LifeSafety Power LifeSafety C8 / C8P
componentModels.notes: Eight controlled zones. Output mode wet/dry and NO/NC behavior depend on jumpers C/E and F; B is positive and A common in wet DC mode. Inputs A/B support configured contact/voltage operation. B1/B2 bus selection and FAI enable are per-zone settings; no jumper positions are inferred.

componentModels.name: LifeSafety Power LifeSafety D8 / D8P
componentModels.edition: P03-007 Rev A11 · February 2021 · printed pages 2–3
componentModels.notes: Eight distribution zones without individual access-control inputs. Zone source is selected from B1/B2 with jumpers. D8 fused and D8P PTC variants differ; no relay or door-trigger input is fabricated.

THE PANIC HARDWARE WILL PERMIT FREE EGRESS AT ALL TIMES. NOTE: THE AUTOMATIC OPERATOR REQUIRES HOLD-OPEN FUNCTIONALITY.
THE INTEGRATED CREDENTIAL READER WILL UNLOCK THE DOOR FOR ENTRY. THE INSIDE HARDWARE WILL PERMIT FREE EGRESS AT ALL TIMES.

PUSHING THE PANIC HARDWARE WILL SOUND THE ALARM HORN AND DELAY EGRESS FOR 15-SECONDS BEFORE UNLOCKING. THE DELAYED EGRESS LOCKING SYSTEM SHALL BE CONNECTED TO THE FIRE ALARM PANEL TO PERMIT THE DOOR TO UNLOCK FOR EGRESS. THE CARD READER LOCATED ON THE PULL SIDE OF THE DOOR IS REQUIRED TO MANUALLY RESET THE DELAYED EGRESS LOCKINGS SYSTEM AFTER INITATION. THE DOOR POSITION SWITCH IS MONITORED BY THE ACCESS CONTROL SYSTEM. NOTE: LOCATE THE DOOR SWEEP ON THE PULL SIDE OF THE DOOR.
THE INTEGRATED CREDENTIAL READER WILL UNLOCK THE DOOR FOR ENTRY. THE INSIDE HARDWARE WILL PERMIT FREE EGRESS AT ALL TIMES. NOTE: LOCATE THE DOOR SWEEPS ON THE PULL SIDE OF THE DOOR.
